checksPerformed: Executed Python contract validation against the supplied handoff, not a game importer. Parsed all 35 JSON files as UTF-8 with duplicate-key and nonfinite-number rejection; verified the exact 36-file set.
Verified schemaVersion 1, exact required wrapper and entry fields, field types, enum values, absence of null/blank placeholder fields, and all specified prose and array length limits.
Verified the full 21-entry registry and manifest paths: 8 recruitment ancestries including wolfkin, 12 summoning ancestries including kitsune and oni, and golem construction.
Verified 100 names, 25 story seeds and 25 appearances per ancestry: 2,100 names, 525 stories and 525 appearances. Verified all 11 shared pools total 445 entries; 3,595 selectable records overall.
Verified all required shared distributions, including 15 values/15 boundaries/10 preferences, 8 social/9 flirtatious/8 adaptable styles, and the six requested garment-slot quantities.

Verified globally unique, sequential, lowercase ASCII kebab-case content IDs; case-folded and trimmed global personal-name uniqueness; and exclusion of every exact reserved name. Candidate generation also filtered a selected conspicuous-name blacklist.
Verified all tag references against the single 100-definition vocabulary, including metaphorDomains and experienceThemes. All 100 tags are used; no undeclared or duplicate tag references were found.

Verified all ancestry restrictions and exclusions, nonempty eligible ancestry sets, conflict-target existence and reverse-link rules. There are no declared pairwise conflicts in this edition, so reverse-link checks are vacuous.

Verified every garment reference, propagation of component exclusions, base coverage as dress OR top plus bottom, one footwear entry per ensemble, no duplicate occupied slots, and no declared incompatible slot combinations. All 60 garments are used by the 30 ensembles.

Ran targeted appearance checks on all 525 records for explicit adult age 18–25, summary/component consistency, required elven palettes, humanlike ear/tail ancestries, orc colour, seraph wings, vampire fangs, dragonkin traits, oni direction and crafted golem materials. Negative screens checked for fixed scene actions, relationships, occupations, outfits and childlike presentation.

Verified all 28 lived-background occupations exclude golems; the remaining roles are 8 prospective vocations and 4 either-mode entries. Screened golem story prose for explicit fabricated childhood, prior careers, former lovers or accumulated years of experience.

Screened selectable text for exact reserved identities, placeholder markers, selected modern-electronics/clothing terms, HTML/model-control phrases, selected automatic/numeric mechanical grants and forced player-action or relationship assertions. This is a targeted heuristic screen, not a semantic proof.

Checked exact duplicates in story titles, premises, motivations and opening hooks, complete appearance bundles within ancestry, and shared labels/descriptions within each pool. Repeated continuity warnings and format scaffolding were intentionally excluded from originality judgments.

Ran automated TF-IDF word-unigram/bigram cosine screening across all 525 story narratives and within each shared pool. No pair reached the 0.60 screening threshold; the highest final story-pair score was 0.147. Scores indicate wording overlap, not semantic originality.

Performed non-automated editorial review by the generating model during authoring and on high-ranked lexical neighbours. Revised 26 similar ancestry-story setups, reviewed personality counterpoints and golem history, and inspected material/anatomy wording and garment fitting notes. This was not independent human review or external clearance.

Reparsed and revalidated the completed report and final pack. ZIP verification checked the single required root folder, 36 unique file members, archive CRC integrity, JSON decoding from archived bytes and byte-for-byte equality with the delivered directory.
knownLimitations: Draft for integration only. The current v0.32 prototype does not automatically import this proposed contract. No game import, execution, application integration or mechanical mapping was performed.

Requirements and requiredEstablishedFacts remain plain-language prerequisites. Empty prerequisite arrays do not create possessions, facilities, contacts, abilities or accepted backstories; the application must validate and explicitly accept candidate facts.

Lexical screening cannot guarantee that plots, traits, voices or names are semantically unique. Names use recurring phonetic families, and shared craft, correspondence, consent and domestic themes recur intentionally. Repeated guardrails are not character dialogue.

No external originality search, copyright clearance, trademark review or comprehensive comparison with fictional characters, celebrities or deity names was performed. Coincidental name matches remain possible despite reserved-name and selected-name filtering.
Editorial inspection was performed by the generating model, not an independent human editor. Rule-based anatomy, agency and history checks cannot prove the absence of every semantic inconsistency.

Current saves, full established NPC biographies and accepted portraits were not provided. Compatibility with canonical history beyond the handoff constraints must be reviewed before integration; existing state remains authoritative.

Appearance bundles and wardrobe combinations require individual anatomical and visual review. No portraits, rendered fitting tests, physical garment patterns or complete character combinations were generated. Some garments intentionally exclude seraphs or golems.

The pack supplies narrative and visual candidates, not permissions or game effects. Summoning, construction, clothing, invitations and flirtation do not establish skills, obedience, affection, romance, intimate contact or Resonance changes.
